body:
I used to use methoxetamine for a while, weeks in a row. The bottom line is 'less is more'. It gives some kind of clarity, with side effects, it lets me be more aware that I live in the universe.
After consuming about 5 grams solo I started to notice neurological damage. I had to quit taking the substance, and now take piracetam with omega 3 and choline, alcar, noopept, pramiracetam, and try to train my brain a bit.
When taking to much to often, its hard to draw the line, I failed.
